purpose: Pin the complete runtime authority used by the foundation review; counts and hashes do not prove semantic coverage.

LIF.definition: The self understood as a continuous identity across time and changing states.
The self as presently conscious, aware, and mentally available.
The self preserved without present conscious expression.
A particular being recognized as distinct from the speaker.
Another being who is presently conscious, awake, or responsive.
Another identified individual whose identity remains preserved but is not presently expressed.
Life understood as a class, category, or shared kind of existence.
A population or community of living beings currently interacting as a living collective.
A population, lineage, or form of life preserved in potential rather than currently active.
A being has completed an inward stage of development and reached a stable new form.
To bring one’s own life, consciousness, or functioning into active expression.
An inward awakening process that is prepared or possible but has not yet begun.
The process of bringing another being into active life has been successfully completed.
To actively cause another being to become conscious, alive, or functionally expressed.
To place another being into a condition from which awakening can later occur.
The formation or development of a population, ecology, or living network has reached a stable completed state.
To actively increase, diversify, or develop life at the population or system level.
To preserve a population, lineage, or living system in a form capable of future restoration or development.
The stable capacity of a being to remain alive and continue functioning.
The active expression of a being’s power to live, act, grow, and recover.
The capacity for an individual life to exist or awaken, although that capacity is not presently expressed.
A stable relationship through which two living identities recognize one another as connected.
The active use of one being’s life-capacity to protect, support, nurture, or sustain another being.
A potential relationship between living identities that has not yet been confirmed, completed, or fully expressed.
A self-sustaining system of living beings and the relationships necessary for their continued existence.
A distributed network in which living beings are actively exchanging support, information, energy, or function.
Life that could validly exist, but has not yet taken individual, collective, or physical form.

MOV.definition: A stable position understood as the source from which movement, measurement, or sequence begins.
The position currently occupied by an entity, signal, process, or point of attention.
A source position that is preserved in memory or data but is not presently occupied.
A stable location identified as the endpoint or target of movement.
A destination that is currently reachable, accepted, and actively guiding movement.
A destination that remains defined but cannot yet be reached, confirmed, or entered.
A stable sequence of positions connecting one location to another.
A system of routes currently carrying movement, traffic, signals, or transitions.
A route, corridor, cycle, or movement network that remains structurally possible but is not presently operating.
Completion of a mover's displacement away from a source position.
Ongoing displacement of a mover away from a source position.
A potential displacement away from a source position that is not presently active or completed.
Completion of a mover's displacement to a target position.
Ongoing displacement of a mover toward a target position.
A potential displacement toward a target position that is not presently active or completed.
Completion of a mover's change of position relative to a shared or environmental reference frame.
Ongoing change of a mover's position relative to a shared or environmental reference frame.
A potential change of a mover's position relative to a shared or environmental reference frame that is not presently active or completed.
An enduring capacity of a mover to change its own position.
A mover's capacity to change its own position that is presently available for exercise.
A mover's capacity to change its own position that exists without being presently available for exercise.
An established positional relation of a mover to a target position.
A positional relation of a mover to a target position that is currently maintained or updated.
An unresolved relation between a mover's position and a target position.
An established positional configuration among loci within a shared reference frame.
A positional configuration among loci that is currently maintained or updated within a shared reference frame.
An unrealized possible positional configuration among loci within a shared reference frame.

MAT.definition: The enduring matter that constitutes a focal entity's physical body.
A focal entity's material substrate in a presently energized physical state.
A focal entity's material substrate persisting without presently expressed physical activity.
A materially bounded body treated as a distinct external object.
A distinct external material object in a presently energized physical state.
A distinct external material object persisting without presently expressed physical activity.
A collection of material constituents treated as one persistent physical aggregate.
A material aggregate whose constituents are presently in collective energetic interaction.
A material aggregate persisting without presently expressed collective physical activity.
Completion of a physical-state change localized within the focal material bearer.
An ongoing physical-state change localized within the focal material bearer.
A possible physical-state change localized within the focal material bearer that is not active or completed.
Completion of a physical-state change localized in a distinct material target.
An ongoing physical-state change localized in a distinct material target.
A possible physical-state change localized in a distinct material target that is not active or completed.
Completion of a physical-state change distributed across materially interacting parts of a shared system.
An ongoing physical-state change distributed across materially interacting parts of a shared system.
A possible physical-state change distributed across materially interacting parts of a shared system that is not active or completed.
A persistent capacity of a material bearer to supply energy for producing physical change.
A material bearer's capacity to supply energy for physical change that is presently available for exercise.
A material bearer's capacity to supply energy for physical change that exists without being presently available for exercise.
An established relation by which a material bearer can transmit physical influence to a distinct target.
A relation by which a material bearer is presently transmitting physical influence to a distinct target.
Whether a material bearer can transmit physical influence to a distinct target is unresolved.
A stable relation in which material parts of a shared system mutually constrain one another's physical states.
A relation in which material parts of a shared system are presently exerting reciprocal physical influence.
An unrealized possible relation in which material parts of a shared system would mutually constrain one another's physical states.

MIN.definition: A mental representation of the cognizer's own identity or condition that persists across cognitive episodes.
A mental representation of the cognizer's own identity or condition that is presently manifest in cognition.
A mental representation of the cognizer's own identity or condition that persists without presently manifesting in cognition.
A mental representation of a distinct target that persists across cognitive episodes.
A mental representation of a distinct target that is presently manifest in cognition.
A mental representation of a distinct target that persists without presently manifesting in cognition.
A mental representation held in common across multiple cognizers that persists across cognitive episodes.
A mental representation held in common across multiple cognizers that is presently manifest among them.
A mental representation held in common across multiple cognizers that persists without presently manifesting among them.
A completed cognitive process whose result is a change to the cognizer's representation of the cognizer's own identity or condition.
An active cognitive process that is changing the cognizer's representation of the cognizer's own identity or condition.
A cognitive process that would change the cognizer's representation of the cognizer's own identity or condition if actualized, but is not active or completed.
A completed cognitive process whose result is a change to a cognizer's representation of a distinct target.
An active cognitive process that is changing a cognizer's representation of a distinct target.
A cognitive process that would change a cognizer's representation of a distinct target if actualized, but is not active or completed.
A completed cognitive process distributed across multiple cognizers whose result is a change to a representation held in common among them.
An active cognitive process distributed across multiple cognizers that is changing a representation held in common among them.
A cognitive process distributed across multiple cognizers that would change a representation held in common among them if actualized, but is not active or completed.
A persistent capacity of a cognizer to allocate cognitive processing selectively.
A cognizer's capacity to allocate cognitive processing selectively that is presently available for exercise.
A cognizer's capacity to allocate cognitive processing selectively that exists without being presently available for exercise.
An established relation in which a cognizer's cognitive processing is preferentially directed toward a distinct target.
A relation in which a cognizer's cognitive processing is presently preferentially directed toward a distinct target.
An unresolved attentional relation between a cognizer and a distinct target whose receipt of preferential cognitive processing is undetermined.
A stable attentional relation among multiple cognizers that gives one target shared cognitive priority.
An attentional relation in which multiple cognizers presently give the same target shared cognitive priority.
An unrealized possible attentional relation in which multiple cognizers would give the same target shared cognitive priority.

CON.definition: A bounded communicative locus that remains identified as the source-side endpoint of an exchange context.
A source-side communicative locus presently participating as an endpoint in an exchange context.
A source-side communicative locus defined for an exchange context without presently participating in it.
A bounded communicative locus that remains identified as the target-side endpoint of an exchange context.
A target-side communicative locus presently participating as an endpoint in an exchange context.
A target-side communicative locus defined for an exchange context without presently participating in it.
A bounded communicative environment that remains the common exchange context of multiple participant endpoints.
A shared communicative environment presently functioning as the common exchange context of multiple participant endpoints.
A shared communicative environment defined for multiple participant endpoints without presently functioning as their common exchange context.
Completion of an act by which a source endpoint makes a communicative expression available to an exchange context.
An ongoing act by which a source endpoint makes a communicative expression available to an exchange context.
A nonactualized act by which a source endpoint would make a communicative expression available to an exchange context.
Completion of an act by which a target endpoint takes up a communicative expression from an exchange context.
An ongoing act by which a target endpoint takes up a communicative expression from an exchange context.
A nonactualized act by which a target endpoint would take up a communicative expression from an exchange context.
Completion of an act by which a communicative expression is made available across a shared channel to multiple participant endpoints.
An ongoing act by which a communicative expression is made available across a shared channel to multiple participant endpoints.
A nonactualized act by which a communicative expression would be made available across a shared channel to multiple participant endpoints.
A persistent capacity of an endpoint to participate in communicative exchange.
A communicative capacity of an endpoint that is presently available for exercise in an exchange.
A communicative capacity of an endpoint that exists without being presently available for exercise.
A persistent relation that identifies a distinct endpoint as the target of communicative exchange from a reference endpoint.
A directed relation from a reference endpoint to a distinct target that is presently operative as a participant link for communicative exchange.
A directed relation from a reference endpoint to a distinct target whose status as a participant link for communicative exchange is undetermined.
A persistent communicative relation among multiple endpoints that constitutes them as co-participants in one shared exchange context.
A communicative relation among multiple endpoints that presently operates to constitute them as co-participants in one shared exchange context.
A not-yet-realized possible communicative relation among multiple endpoints that would constitute them as co-participants in one shared exchange context.

STR.definition: A position within a structure that remains identified as a place for one constituent independently of its present occupancy.
A position within a structure that is presently occupied by a constituent.
A position within a structure that is defined for a constituent but presently unoccupied.
A boundary locus of a structure that remains identified for structural engagement by a distinct external target.
A boundary locus of a structure that is presently engaged by a distinct external target.
A boundary locus of a structure that is defined for engagement by a distinct external target but presently unengaged.
A part–whole arrangement that remains identified as one structure across multiple constituent positions.
A part–whole arrangement that is presently realized as one structure by constituents occupying multiple constituent positions.
A part–whole arrangement that is defined across multiple constituent positions without presently being realized as one structure.
Completion of a structural transformation that changes how a reference structure's own constituents occupy its internal positions.
An ongoing structural transformation that changes how a reference structure's own constituents occupy its internal positions.
A nonactualized structural transformation that would change how a reference structure's own constituents occupy its internal positions.
Completion of a structural transformation by which a distinct target becomes incorporated into a reference structure.
An ongoing structural transformation by which a distinct target becomes incorporated into a reference structure.
A nonactualized structural transformation by which a distinct target would become incorporated into a reference structure.
Completion of a structural transformation by which multiple structures become organized as constituents of one composite arrangement.
An ongoing structural transformation by which multiple structures become organized as constituents of one composite arrangement.
A nonactualized structural transformation by which multiple structures would become organized as constituents of one composite arrangement.
A persistent capacity of a reference structure to reassign its own constituents among its internal positions while preserving that structure as the reference whole.
A capacity of a reference structure to reassign its own constituents among its internal positions that is presently available for exercise while preserving that structure as the reference whole.

A capacity of a reference structure to reassign its own constituents among its internal positions that exists without being presently available for exercise while preserving that structure as the reference whole.
A persistent structural relation that qualifies one distinct target for incorporation as a constituent of a reference structure while preserving the reference as the organizing whole.
A structural relation that presently qualifies one distinct target for incorporation as a constituent of a reference structure while preserving the reference as the organizing whole.
An unresolved structural relation between a reference structure and one distinct target whose qualification for incorporation as a constituent remains undetermined.
A persistent structural relation among multiple structures that qualifies them for organization as peer constituents of one higher-order composite distinct from every input.
A structural relation among multiple structures that presently qualifies them for organization as peer constituents of one higher-order composite distinct from every input.
An unrealized structural possibility that multiple structures could qualify for organization as peer constituents of one higher-order composite distinct from every input.

WRN.definition: An intrinsic adverse condition that remains identified within one reference entity independently of whether it is presently producing harmful deviation.
An intrinsic adverse condition within one reference entity that is presently producing harmful deviation from that entity's accepted state.
An intrinsic adverse condition within one reference entity that is present without presently producing harmful deviation.
A distinct external condition that remains identified as capable of adversely affecting one reference target independently of current contact or effect.
A distinct external condition that is presently expressing the harmful potential by which it can adversely affect one reference target.
A distinct external condition capable of adversely affecting one reference target that is present without presently expressing that harmful potential.
One correlated adverse condition that remains identified across multiple participant entities within a shared system independently of its present manifestation pattern.
One correlated adverse condition that is presently producing harmful deviation across multiple participant entities within a shared system.
One correlated adverse condition present across multiple participant entities within a shared system without presently producing harmful deviation.
Completion of an adverse transformation originating within one reference entity by which that entity enters a less acceptable condition.
An ongoing adverse transformation originating within one reference entity by which that entity is entering a less acceptable condition.
A nonactualized adverse transformation originating within one reference entity by which that entity would enter a less acceptable condition.
Completion of an adverse transformation by which one distinct source causes one reference target to enter a less acceptable condition.
An ongoing adverse transformation by which one distinct source causes one reference target to enter a less acceptable condition.
A nonactualized adverse transformation by which one distinct source would cause one reference target to enter a less acceptable condition.
Completion of an adverse transformation by which one correlated adverse condition becomes distributed across multiple participant entities within a shared system.
An ongoing adverse transformation by which one correlated adverse condition becomes distributed across multiple participant entities within a shared system.
A nonactualized adverse transformation by which one correlated adverse condition would become distributed across multiple participant entities within a shared system.
A persistent susceptibility of one reference entity to undergo internally originating degradation under qualifying conditions, independently of whether that susceptibility is presently operative.
A susceptibility of one reference entity to undergo internally originating degradation that is presently operative under the applicable conditions.
A susceptibility of one reference entity to undergo internally originating degradation that exists without being presently operative under the applicable conditions.

A persistent exposure relation between one distinct hazard source and one reference target that can enable source-to-target impairment under qualifying conditions, independently of whether that relation is presently operative.
An exposure relation between one distinct hazard source and one reference target that presently enables that source to cause target impairment under the applicable conditions.
An exposure relation between one distinct hazard source and one reference target that exists without presently enabling that source to cause target impairment under the applicable conditions.

A persistent pathway relation across multiple participants in one shared system through which one correlated adverse condition can become distributed, independently of whether that pathway is presently operative.
A pathway relation across multiple participants in one shared system that presently enables one correlated adverse condition to become distributed among them.
A pathway relation across multiple participants in one shared system through which one correlated adverse condition can become distributed but that is not presently operative.

REP.definition: An acceptable condition internal to one reference entity that remains identified as that entity's restoration standard independently of whether it is presently realized.
An acceptable condition internal to one reference entity that is presently realized as that entity's restored state.
An acceptable condition internal to one reference entity that remains identified as its restoration standard without being presently realized.
An acceptable condition of one distinct reference target that remains identified as that target's restoration standard independently of whether it is presently realized.
An acceptable condition of one distinct reference target that is presently realized as that target's restored state.
An acceptable condition of one distinct reference target that remains identified as its restoration standard without being presently realized.
One correlated acceptable condition that remains identified across multiple participant entities within a shared system as their restoration standard independently of its present realization pattern.
One correlated acceptable condition that is presently realized across multiple participant entities within a shared system as their restored state.
One correlated acceptable condition that remains identified across multiple participant entities within a shared system as their restoration standard without being presently realized.
Completion of a restorative transformation originating within one reference entity by which that entity enters its applicable internal restoration condition.
An ongoing restorative transformation originating within one reference entity by which that entity is entering its applicable internal restoration condition.
A nonactualized restorative transformation originating within one reference entity by which that entity would enter its applicable internal restoration condition.
Completion of a restorative transformation by which one distinct source causes one reference target to enter its applicable target restoration condition.
An ongoing restorative transformation by which one distinct source causes one reference target to enter its applicable target restoration condition.
A nonactualized restorative transformation by which one distinct source would cause one reference target to enter its applicable target restoration condition.
Completion of a coordinated restorative transformation by which one shared restoration condition becomes realized across multiple participant entities within one shared system.
An ongoing coordinated restorative transformation by which one shared restoration condition is becoming realized across multiple participant entities within one shared system.
A nonactualized coordinated restorative transformation by which one shared restoration condition would become realized across multiple participant entities within one shared system.
A persistent capacity of one reference entity to undergo internally originating restoration under qualifying conditions, independently of whether that capacity is presently operative.
A capacity of one reference entity to undergo internally originating restoration that is presently operative under the applicable conditions.
A capacity of one reference entity to undergo internally originating restoration that exists without being presently operative under the applicable conditions.

A persistent restorative applicability relation between one distinct source and one reference target that can enable source-to-target restoration under qualifying conditions, independently of whether that relation is presently operative.
A restorative applicability relation between one distinct source and one reference target that presently enables that source to cause target restoration under the applicable conditions.

A restorative applicability relation between one distinct source and one reference target that exists without presently enabling that source to cause target restoration under the applicable conditions.

A persistent pathway relation across multiple participants in one shared system through which one shared restoration condition can become realized, independently of whether that pathway is presently operative.
A pathway relation across multiple participants in one shared system that presently enables one shared restoration condition to become realized among them.
A pathway relation across multiple participants in one shared system through which one shared restoration condition can become realized but that is not presently operative.

LOG.definition: A persistent formal criterion within the logical specification of one reference entity that limits that entity's admissible states independently of whether the criterion is presently operative.
A formal criterion within the logical specification of one reference entity that is presently operative in limiting that entity's admissible states.
A formal criterion within the logical specification of one reference entity that remains defined without presently operating to limit that entity's admissible states.
A persistent formal constraint assigned to one distinct reference target that limits the target's admissible states independently of whether the constraint is presently operative.
A formal constraint assigned to one distinct reference target that is presently operative in limiting the target's admissible states.
A formal constraint assigned to one distinct reference target that remains defined without presently operating to limit the target's admissible states.
A persistent formal regime that correlates admissibility criteria across multiple participants in one shared rule domain independently of whether the regime is presently operative.
A formal regime that is presently operative in correlating admissibility criteria across multiple participants in one shared rule domain.
A formal regime that remains defined across multiple participants in one shared rule domain without presently operating to correlate their admissibility criteria.
Completion of a formal evaluation that determines the admissibility of one reference entity under its applicable internal criterion.
An ongoing formal evaluation that is determining the admissibility of one reference entity under its applicable internal criterion.
A nonactualized formal evaluation that would determine the admissibility of one reference entity under its applicable internal criterion.
Completion of a formal evaluation that applies one specified constraint to one distinct reference target and determines that target's admissibility under the constraint.
An ongoing formal evaluation that applies one specified constraint to one distinct reference target and is determining that target's admissibility under the constraint.
A nonactualized formal evaluation that would apply one specified constraint to one distinct reference target and determine that target's admissibility under the constraint.
Completion of a coordinated formal evaluation that determines the joint admissibility of multiple participants under one shared formal regime.
An ongoing coordinated formal evaluation that is determining the joint admissibility of multiple participants under one shared formal regime.
A nonactualized coordinated formal evaluation that would determine the joint admissibility of multiple participants under one shared formal regime.
A persistent capacity of one reference entity to undergo formal evaluation under its applicable internal criterion, independently of whether that capacity is presently operative.
A capacity of one reference entity to undergo formal evaluation under its applicable internal criterion that is presently operative.
A capacity of one reference entity to undergo formal evaluation under its applicable internal criterion that exists without being presently operative.

A persistent formal applicability relation between one specified constraint and one distinct reference target that can enable target constraint application, independently of whether that relation is presently operative.
A formal applicability relation between one specified constraint and one distinct reference target that presently enables target constraint application.
A formal applicability relation between one specified constraint and one distinct reference target that exists without presently enabling target constraint application.
A persistent capacity of multiple participants under one shared formal regime to undergo one coordinated joint evaluation, independently of whether that capacity is presently operative.
A capacity of multiple participants under one shared formal regime to undergo one coordinated joint evaluation that is presently operative.
A capacity of multiple participants under one shared formal regime to undergo one coordinated joint evaluation that exists without being presently operative.

DAT.definition: A persistent bounded information object maintained within one reference entity, independently of whether that information object is presently manifest.
A bounded information object that is presently manifest within one reference entity.
A bounded information object that remains maintained within one reference entity without being presently manifest.
A persistent bounded information object whose content denotes one distinct reference target, independently of whether that referential content is presently manifest.
A bounded information object whose content presently manifests a reference to one distinct reference target.
A bounded information object whose content denotes one distinct reference target without presently manifesting that reference.

A persistent coordinated collection of information objects maintained as one shared dataset across multiple participants in one information domain, independently of whether that dataset is presently manifest.
A coordinated collection of information objects that is presently manifest as one shared dataset across multiple participants in one information domain.
A coordinated collection of information objects maintained as one shared dataset across multiple participants in one information domain without being presently manifest.
Completion of a bounded transformation of represented information within one reference entity, yielding transformed information without transferring it to a distinct target.
An ongoing bounded transformation of represented information within one reference entity that is producing transformed information without transferring it to a distinct target.
A nonactualized bounded transformation that would transform represented information within one reference entity without transferring it to a distinct target.
Completion of a bounded information transfer from one source context to one distinct reference target, causing that target to receive the transferred information.
An ongoing bounded information transfer from one source context to one distinct reference target that is causing that target to receive the transferred information.
A nonactualized bounded information transfer that would carry information from one source context to one distinct reference target.
Completion of a coordinated information-state alignment across multiple participants in one shared data domain under one synchronization criterion.
An ongoing coordinated information-state alignment across multiple participants in one shared data domain under one synchronization criterion.
A nonactualized coordinated process that would align information states across multiple participants in one shared data domain under one synchronization criterion.
A persistent capacity of represented information within one reference entity to undergo bounded internal data transformation, independently of whether that capacity is presently operative.
A capacity of represented information within one reference entity to undergo bounded internal data transformation that is presently operative.
A capacity of represented information within one reference entity to undergo bounded internal data transformation that exists without being presently operative.

A persistent information-transfer relation between one source context and one distinct reference target that can enable bounded target data transfer, independently of whether that relation is presently operative.
An information-transfer relation between one source context and one distinct reference target that presently enables bounded target data transfer.
An information-transfer relation between one source context and one distinct reference target that exists without presently enabling bounded target data transfer.

A persistent capacity of information states across multiple participants in one shared data domain to undergo coordinated alignment under one synchronization criterion, independently of whether that capacity is presently operative.
A capacity of information states across multiple participants in one shared data domain to undergo coordinated alignment under one synchronization criterion that is presently operative.

A capacity of information states across multiple participants in one shared data domain to undergo coordinated alignment under one synchronization criterion that exists without being presently operative.

CRE.definition: A persistent bounded form-specifying pattern maintained within one reference entity as a source for production, independently of whether that pattern is presently expressed.
A bounded form-specifying pattern maintained within one reference entity that is presently expressed as a source for production.
A bounded form-specifying pattern maintained within one reference entity as a source for production without being presently expressed.
A persistent bounded product whose identity derives from a productive transformation directed outward from a source, independently of whether that product is presently manifest.
A bounded product of a productive transformation directed outward from a source that is presently manifest.
A bounded product whose identity derives from a productive transformation directed outward from a source and remains maintained without being presently manifest.
A persistent coordinated collection of generative patterns maintained across multiple participants as one shared production resource, independently of whether that repertoire is presently expressed.
A coordinated collection of generative patterns maintained across multiple participants as one shared production resource that is presently expressed.
A coordinated collection of generative patterns maintained across multiple participants as one shared production resource without being presently expressed.
Completion of a bounded productive transformation within one reference entity that forms or modifies a generative pattern while retaining it within that entity.
An ongoing bounded productive transformation within one reference entity that is forming or modifying a generative pattern while retaining it within that entity.
A nonactualized bounded productive transformation that would form or modify a generative pattern within one reference entity while retaining it within that entity.
Completion of a bounded productive transformation directed outward from one source that brings one generated artifact into manifestation.
An ongoing bounded productive transformation directed outward from one source that is bringing one generated artifact into manifestation.
A nonactualized bounded productive transformation directed outward from one source that would bring one generated artifact into manifestation.
Completion of a coordinated productive transformation by multiple participants in one shared production domain that generates one jointly constituted result.
An ongoing coordinated productive transformation by multiple participants in one shared production domain that is generating one jointly constituted result.
A nonactualized coordinated productive transformation by multiple participants in one shared production domain that would generate one jointly constituted result.
A persistent capacity within one reference entity to form or modify a generative pattern while retaining it within that entity, independently of whether that capacity is presently operative.
A capacity within one reference entity to form or modify a generative pattern while retaining it within that entity that is presently operative.
A capacity within one reference entity to form or modify a generative pattern while retaining it within that entity that exists without being presently operative.

A persistent generative relation from one source toward one distinct prospective artifact that can enable the artifact to be brought into manifestation by productive transformation, independently of whether that relation is presently operative.
A generative relation from one source toward one distinct prospective artifact that presently enables the artifact to be brought into manifestation by productive transformation.
A generative relation from one source toward one distinct prospective artifact that exists without presently enabling the artifact to be brought into manifestation by productive transformation.

A persistent capacity of multiple participants in one shared production domain to generate one jointly constituted result through coordinated productive transformation, independently of whether that capacity is presently operative.
A capacity of multiple participants in one shared production domain to generate one jointly constituted result through coordinated productive transformation that is presently operative.

A capacity of multiple participants in one shared production domain to generate one jointly constituted result through coordinated productive transformation that exists without being presently operative.

ORI.definition: A persistent ontological condition by which one referent is grounded as a source from which another state of affairs may originate, independently of whether that grounding is presently operative.
An ontological condition by which one referent is grounded as a source from which another state of affairs may originate and that grounding is presently operative.
An ontological condition by which one referent is grounded as a source from which another state of affairs may originate and that grounding exists without being presently operative.
A persistent ontological condition under which one distinct referent obtains as part of the relevant reality, independently of whether it is presently manifesting or changing.
An ontological condition under which one distinct referent is presently manifesting or changing as part of the relevant reality.
An ontological condition under which one distinct referent belongs to the relevant reality without presently manifesting or changing within it.
A persistent ontological condition that jointly constrains what obtains across one shared reality, independently of whether that condition is presently being expressed through change.
An ontological condition that is presently being expressed through change across one shared reality.
An ontological condition that belongs to one shared reality without presently being expressed through change across it.
Completion of a bounded ontological transition by which one referent becomes grounded as a source from which another state of affairs may originate.
An ongoing bounded ontological transition by which one referent is becoming grounded as a source from which another state of affairs may originate.
A nonactualized bounded ontological transition that would ground one referent as a source from which another state of affairs may originate.
Completion of a bounded ontological transition by which one distinct referent comes to obtain as part of the relevant reality.
An ongoing bounded ontological transition by which one distinct referent is coming to obtain as part of the relevant reality.
A nonactualized bounded ontological transition by which one distinct referent would come to obtain as part of the relevant reality.
Completion of a bounded ontological transition by which what obtains across one shared reality changes under one jointly applicable world condition.
An ongoing bounded ontological transition by which what obtains across one shared reality is changing under one jointly applicable world condition.
A nonactualized bounded ontological transition by which what obtains across one shared reality would change under one jointly applicable world condition.
A persistent ontological capacity of one source to ground a specified state of affairs, independently of whether that capacity is presently operative.
An ontological capacity of one source that is presently operative in grounding a specified state of affairs.
An ontological capacity of one source to ground a specified state of affairs that belongs to it without being presently operative.
A persistent ontological relation under which one target's obtaining is conditional on a specified ground, independently of whether that dependence is presently operative.
An ontological relation that is presently conditioning one target's obtaining on a specified ground.
An ontological relation under which one target's obtaining would be conditional on a specified ground, without that dependence being presently operative.
A persistent ontological relation that limits which states may coherently obtain across one shared reality, independently of whether it is presently operative.
An ontological relation that is presently limiting which states may coherently obtain across one shared reality.
An ontological relation that belongs to the admissible order of one shared reality without presently limiting which states obtain within it.

compounds.title: physical tool
compounds.definition: A generated artifact with enduring physical work capacity.

compounds.title: ongoing internal structural repair
compounds.definition: An ongoing restorative transformation originating within one reference structure whose restorative transformation changes how that structure's constituents occupy its internal positions.

compounds.title: living communication network
compounds.definition: An active shared channel whose participating exchange context is an active living network.

compounds.title: physical repair
compounds.definition: A completed target restoration whose restorative transformation is a completed target material change.

compounds.title: ongoing physical repair
compounds.definition: An ongoing source-to-target restorative transformation whose restorative transformation is an ongoing physical-state change localized in that distinct material target.

compounds.title: shared-world law
compounds.definition: A persistent shared-world constraint organized as a persistent shared formal regime.

compounds.title: dormant living body
compounds.definition: A dormant material substrate that preserves the identity of a dormant living being.

compounds.title: program definition
compounds.definition: A persistent internal generative pattern represented as bounded data and constrained by a persistent target-directed formal constraint.

compounds.title: living body
compounds.definition: A persistent material substrate constituting an identified living being.

compounds.title: backup dataset
compounds.definition: A dormant shared dataset maintained in relation to a persistent systemic restoration pathway.

compounds.title: material biosystem
compounds.definition: A stable biosystem whose interacting participants are treated as one material aggregate.

compounds.title: shared knowledge base
compounds.definition: A persistent shared dataset organized by a persistent shared cognitive schema.

compounds.title: love
compounds.definition: An established life-bond characterized by self-awakening and the preserved, not-yet-expressed self.

compounds.title: formal ontological dependence
compounds.definition: A persistent target-ground dependence constrained by a persistent target-directed formal constraint.

compounds.title: message datum
compounds.definition: A persistent bounded datum maintained as content within a shared communicative channel.

compounds.title: material artifact
compounds.definition: A generated artifact whose bounded product is material.

compounds.title: data transfer channel
compounds.definition: A persistent target-directed data-transferability relation situated in a persistent shared communicative channel.

compounds.title: directed data link
compounds.definition: An established directed communication relation between open source and target participants whose exchanged content is a bounded datum.

compounds.title: machine
compounds.definition: A generated artifact that is both a persistent composite arrangement and a bearer of enduring physical work capacity.

compounds.title: synchronized data network
compounds.definition: A persistent systemic data-synchronizability relation situated among enduring co-participants in one shared exchange context.

compounds.title: material route
compounds.definition: An established route realized by a stable material aggregate.

compounds.title: shared message collection
compounds.definition: A persistent shared dataset maintained as communicative content within a persistent shared channel.

compounds.title: ongoing internal data repair
compounds.definition: An ongoing restorative transformation originating within one reference entity whose restorative transformation is an ongoing bounded transformation of represented information within that entity, without transfer to a distinct target.

compounds.title: dormant program
compounds.definition: A dormant internal generative pattern represented by dormant data under a dormant target-directed formal constraint.

compounds.title: composite artifact
compounds.definition: A generated artifact organized as a persistent part–whole arrangement.

compounds.title: data repair
compounds.definition: A completed internal restoration whose restorative transformation is a completed internal data transformation.

compounds.title: material hazard
compounds.definition: A persistent external hazard that is a distinct material object.

compounds.title: addressed message
compounds.definition: A persistent target reference maintained as content for a persistent target communicative endpoint.

compounds.title: dormant machine
compounds.definition: A dormant generated artifact whose composite arrangement and physical work capacity persist without present operation.

compounds.title: generated living being
compounds.definition: An identified living being whose individual existence is a generated artifact.

compounds.title: structural repair
compounds.definition: A completed internal restoration whose restorative transformation is a completed internal structural reconfiguration.

compounds.title: physical injury
compounds.definition: A persistent internal fault inhering in a persistent material substrate.
